title: 솔웨이 퍼스의 사진

images.prompt: A small child silhouette standing alone in a misty English marshland meadow, seen from behind, faceless, empty tall grass all around, low cold light, nobody else there, upper fifth of the frame is empty pale sky.
1960s England: a faceless silhouette of a man holding a box camera at his waist standing on marsh grass, far behind him a parked old car, grey afternoon, wide empty moor.
A dim darkroom with a red safelight, photographic prints hanging on a line, the images blurred and unreadable, a tray of developer, nobody there.

An old grainy black and white photographic print held between two fingers, showing a small child silhouette standing in marsh grass and, standing close behind her, a tall pale indistinct standing figure with no face, blurred, dim darkroom red light.
Extreme close-up of an old grainy black and white print: a pale standing figure shape, indistinct, with a smooth blank blur where a face would be, harsh film grain, dark vignette.
